jobs.description: Silver refresh of the 토지소유 lane `land-ownership` (root ADR-0169 ③, ADR-0360): pick the newest vintage whose AL_D161 objects cover every 시도 the lane contract requires, read from the ZIP members measured beside the Bronze ledger, and, unless silver.land_ownership already records it or a newer one (`unchanged`), export each object, stage it on a load branch, compare it with the table's current rows key bucket by key bucket and append to main only the changed parcels' rows and a removal marker per vanished parcel (lane contract compare.content_columns; root ADR-0311, ADR-0318), and read it back (`changed`). Started when a source_sweep run lands new files, and daily as the fallback (root ADR-0171). One lane runs at a time: each takes the compose `spark` cap.

expected_outcome.no_change_bound_reason: Its provider publishes on no fixed day (expected_cadence `irregular` in docs/catalog/public-source-endpoint-catalog.v1.json), so a run that finds nothing new is healthy. That it keeps finishing is the done bound.

assets.title: 필지별 토지소유
assets.description: 토지소유 AL_D161 CSV 의 필지·공유인(집합건물이면 호)마다 소유구분·거주지구분·국가기관구분·소유권변동원인·변동일자·공유인수를 쌓는다(루트 ADR-0360). 사람 이름은 원천에 없다. 판이 오면 바뀐 필지의 행만 덧붙인다.

dependencies.description: D161 CSV만 연결한다. 같은 원천의 D160 도형은 Bronze에 남는다. 지목·면적·공시지가는 토지특성·개별공시지가가 가지므로 버린다.
dependencies.pnu_resolution: the provider's 고유번호 column is the 19-digit PNU, parsed and refused when malformed at Silver (export-land-ownership-silver-handoff); subdivision convergence tracked by ADR-0288
